This '''B1-series battle droid''' was stationed at the [[Rhydonium mining installation]] on the planet [[Abafar]]. Between [[20 BBY]] and [[19 BBY]], the droid was part of a task force at the mining installation; the force's mission was to acquire [[rhydonium]] and load it onto the hijacked [[Venator-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Renown]]'' in Abafar's orbit so they could destroy the [[Republic strategy conference]] in the [[Carida system]]. When [[D-Squad]] tried getting to the ''Renown'' by using the [[D-Squad's shuttle|shuttle]] that was being used to load the rhydonium onto the [[Star Destroyer]], this B1-series battle droid stopped them and demanded that they show their authorization when they got to the mining installation. Immediately afterwards, this droid and his fellow droid were both shot and destroyed by the [[clone commando]] [[Gregor]], who was helping D-Squad with their escape.<ref name="MIA" />
